mintIncidents.summary: Prime was also affected by the June 21 forceDeallocate disruption: its exact VaultV2 event moved 500,065.514514 USDC from the cbBTC market to vault idle, with zero penalty. The Prime monitoring agent set the adapter penalty to 0.5% that evening; its rebalancer redeployed the exact displaced amount across WETH and cbBTC on June 22. This is a local allocation/share-burning control incident, not arbitrary USDC issuance or theft. Resolution describes this episode only: later penalty resets and further forceDeallocate events remain in the reviewed history, so a permanent elimination of griefing is not claimed. The active-adapter penalty is 0.01% at block 26191269 (2026-10-14), with a zero-delay setter.
